## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Case normalization in the new setter should be fixed: mixed-case writes cannot be retrieved. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds `Cache.set`, raises the default TTL to 300 seconds, and adds round-trip and expiry tests.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — Normalize keys before storing entries — Calling `set("ALPHA", 1)` makes subsequent `get("ALPHA")` and `get("alpha")` return `None`: you store the original key, but `get` lowercases its lookup at line 17. The added round-trip test only writes a lowercase key. — Callers using uppercase or mixed-case keys lose access to their cached values, and those entries escape expiry cleanup through `get`.
